method: Static source tracing, decoded PHP recovery, full member-hash upstream comparisons, atomscan slow/local and cleave facts; no sample code executed.

provenance.identity: ProjectDiscovery nuclei-templates v10.2.5 Go module ZIP
provenance.explanation: Nested-module directory excluded by Go module ZIP packaging; no modified or extra sample file.

40eb92a803aa: tao-run-deft-aoi records approved metric/network/GPU policy, resumes a disk-backed stage machine, prepares models and training data, calls underlying TAO workflows, and writes local evaluation/report artifacts.

deft_exec.run reads immutable execution_policy, rejects network/package/registry commands in airgap mode, adds Docker no-pull/offline environment flags, and passes the requested argument vector to subprocess.run.
deft_python.sh selects an existing dependency-complete interpreter; it neither installs packages nor downloads code. stage_backbone reads HF_TOKEN for the configured Hugging Face model service.

team-request.yml checks collaborator admin/maintain permission, resolves a PR SHA and watched changes, then dispatches NVIDIA CI with the provided dispatch credential. sync-skills.yml clones configured source repositories, syncs skill trees and opens a PR.

The apparent AI-agent command in sync-skills.yml was a .claude-plugin/marketplace.json path. Seven alleged pip launches in original members were error/remediation/version strings, not pip installations.

The strongest classifier leaves are JSON evaluation configurations misidentified as XML because of their .config extension. Their prompts describe GPU/Docker smoke tests, intended service authentication, and cleanup of the test workspace.
96501cc54afd: assign_tasks.py uses the supplied GitHub token for issue/PR assignee and review-request API calls. wordpress-plugins-update.py fetches public plugin pages/readmes and writes local version helpers and detection templates. .review-bot is reviewer guidance with scanner examples.
CVE-2019-5434 constructs a serialized XML-RPC file-write probe. Its Base64 decodes to <?php system($_GET["0"]); ?>; a second request supplies 0=id and verifies uid/gid output.

CVE-2025-32101 URL-decodes to a Guzzle FileCookieJar gadget storing <?php eval(base64_decode($_SERVER['HTTP_X'])); ?> in a PHP file; follow-up requests send a Base64-encoded id command through X and check output.

These are invasive exploit-testing capabilities supplied to an explicit scanner target. Existing notable request-to-shell, decoded-header evaluation, serialization and codec traits accurately describe them and remain unchanged.

Swagger extensionless fixture embeds a browser event-handler fetch/eval chain; its referenced JavaScript is alert(window.origin). This is an XSS confirmation payload, not host-side installation or credential export.
0923aa1ed19a: AuthenticationService.authenticate chooses configured local or external LDAP authentication, configures the resulting session, records metrics and applies authentication protection; credential handling serves the declared identity-provider role.
Cedarling build.rs reads git revision/build metadata and optionally generates protobuf bindings. The C binding build script generates a header with cbindgen.

sigstore-verifier/build.rs reads embedded trust files, Base64-decodes PEM, parses DER certificates, checks CA/keyCertSign/expiry and validates EC public-key OIDs. This is build-time trust validation, not theft or an install-hook payload.
.github/actions/opa-up starts the configured Docker Compose service, polls localhost:8181/health and emits logs on failure. PR automation creates/links issues through intended GitHub APIs.
The top classifier leaf is the Jans Chip demo AndroidManifest.xml: INTERNET permission, backup settings, a normal exported launcher activity, and no embedded executable payload.

rule_changes.change: Replace vendor-name token matching with four shell-command-position matchers; retain plugin-directory reference as neutral CI metadata.
rule_changes.unsupported_claim: A .claude-plugin path, echoed example or comment does not invoke an AI agent.
rule_changes.retained: Direct, absolute-path and npx commands; downstream unattended issue-agent consumers exercised separately for all four families.

rule_changes.unsupported_claim: Passing an issue number to assign_tasks.py establishes no agent identity.
rule_changes.retained: Matcher and scope unchanged; both exact objective consumers updated.

rule_changes.change: Remove two generic skill-directory observations from the Anthropic cybersecurity software-identity bucket and from identity-based suppressors.
rule_changes.unsupported_claim: skills/<slug>/scripts and skills/security paths do not identify that corpus or defensive intent.
rule_changes.retained: Existing neutral agent-skill-directory-member covers affected ordinary members; companion-script layout fact covers Lua and PowerShell. Reverse-shell and setup-hook controls remain detected under skill paths.

rule_changes.change: Bind python-pip-module-command to Python execution calls receiving a pip install string.
rule_changes.unsupported_claim: Dependency error messages, forbidden-command messages and python -m pip --version strings do not install packages.
rule_changes.retained: Real subprocess pip invocation and the pre-existing setup-hook fixture remain detected.

rule_changes.change: Match ensurepip.bootstrap calls, at notable severity; preserve quoted ensurepip references separately under source-literal metadata.
rule_changes.unsupported_claim: Importing/probing ensurepip or mentioning its module name does not bootstrap pip.
rule_changes.retained: Real bootstrap call and source-module reference have independent controls.

rule_changes.change: Relocate architecture-parameter-assignment unchanged to metadata/lang/source/syntax/assignment; update exact and architecture-token consumers.
rule_changes.unsupported_claim: arch=/architecture= can be a model/configuration label, not a host-architecture operation.
rule_changes.retained: Nearby real host queries retain architecture-parameter-with-host-query; broad sysinfo consumers continue to require actual sysinfo evidence rather than a bare variable name.

rule_changes.change: Add Rust X509Certificate::from_der call coverage. Remove certificate-usage suppression of PEM-path references.
rule_changes.unsupported_claim: Parsing a certificate does not make its referenced PEM path inaccurate or redundant.
rule_changes.retained: Certificate parser and PEM-path observations coexist; a quoted parser example does not match the call trait.

verification.staging: Fixture copies are scanned outside test-directory suppressors; no fixture is executed.
verification.external_control: Forager recovered the original Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills pass-the-ticket process.py; traced command generation/offline conversion without running it. Artifact and .forage.json remain in scratch.

limitations: No deployment history or target authorization was supplied; exact upstream packaging and the traced intended workflows tip all three artifact verdicts to BENIGN.

The installed v18.18 classifier feature schema is older than the engine feature schema. XML/config metadata and explicit exploit probes still drive HOSTILE classifications; inaccurate rules were not restored to manipulate those scores.

The extensionless Swagger fixture is identified as unknown and omitted from archive program analysis; it was inspected manually. A reliable behavior match there requires analyzer admission/content extraction support, not a filename-only YAML conviction.
Fetched mutable GitHub pages and package dependencies can change the lower-tier member population between scans. Original archive bytes and all hostile/suspicious findings were compared separately.
